name: License Key Manager for WooCommerce
author: Eilmo

sections.description:
License Key Manager for WooCommerce is a powerful WordPress plugin designed to help store owners manage license keys for their products seamlessly. This plugin allows you to generate unique license keys for each product, validate these keys, and keep track of their usage, all from the WooCommerce backend.

Key Features

  • Generate unique license keys for WooCommerce products.
  • Validate license keys with ease.
  • View and manage license key usage statistics.
  • Customizable license key settings for each product.
  • Secure storage and organization of license keys.

Core Features List

  • Simple Dashboard
  • Unique License Key Generation
  • License Key Validation System
  • Usage Statistics Tracking
  • Customizable License Settings
  • Add License Type (Limited or Unlimited)
  • Issue Date Management
  • Validation Period (in Days)
  • Maximum Activations Control
  • Status Options (Active, Inactive, Deactivated, Expired, Canceled)
  • Secure Data Management
  • REST API Endpoints
  • Export/Import All License Keys

Ideal Users of WooCommerce License Manager

  • WordPress Plugin & Theme Developers Securing Premium Products.
  • Manage Game Keys, Digital Gift Cards, Software Licenses, and Activation Codes.
  • SaaS & Subscription Software Providers Managing Licenses.
  • Digital Product Stores with Safe License Distribution.
  • Agencies & Freelancers Tracking Client Licenses Easily.
  • Any physical or digital product that needs a license, activation code, or unique key.
  • And many more.
sections.installation:
1. Unzip the downloaded zip file and upload the plugin folder into the wp-content/plugins/ directory. Alternatively, upload from Plugins >> Add New >> Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins page.
sections.faq:
What is License Key Manager for WooCommerce?

License Key Manager for WooCommerce is a WordPress plugin that allows store owners to generate, validate, and manage license keys for their WooCommerce products efficiently.

How does the license key generation work?

The plugin generates unique license keys for each product, which can be customized and managed from the plugin settings.

Can I validate the license keys?

Yes, the plugin includes a validation system to ensure that the license keys are legitimate and have not been used beyond their limits.

Where can I find support or report issues?

For support or to report any issues, please visit the plugin’s GitHub repository or use the donate link provided.
